description: Forecast weather along a route, each sample read for the hour you actually reach it rather than the weather right now. Pass the route's `shape` (an encoded polyline6, the `route` tool's geometry_polyline6), optional `depart_at` (RFC 3339, default now), the route's `duration_s` (from `route`; omitted, an 80 km/h average is assumed and `duration_source` says so) and optional `sample_interval_m` (default 25,000, 5,000 to 100,000, at most 40 samples). Each sample carries its ETA, temperature, rain, snowfall, precipitation type and probability, wind and gust speed, visibility, the WMO weather code and `severe` (thunderstorm and heavy precipitation codes only). It is a FORECAST, not an observation: read on a 0.05 degree grid (about 5.5 km) at the nearest hour, up to 16 days ahead, and samples past that horizon or without data come back `available: false` with a reason, never painted dry. `summary` is one sentence (where rain or snow starts and for how far, the strongest gust, samples without data) and always ends by saying it is advisory, never a routing guarantee: keep that qualifier when you pass it on. Requires the MapMap gateway; a deployment without a weather source answers a clear error. Display the returned `attribution` with the forecast, linked to `attribution_url`, with `licence_url` (CC BY 4.0) linked; `derived_fields` names the sample fields MapMap derives rather than Open-Meteo supplies.

depart_at.description:
Departure time, RFC 3339 (e.g. "2026-10-12T14:00:00Z"); defaults to
now. Forecasts reach about 16 days ahead; samples past that answer
unavailable.

duration_s.description:
The route's duration in seconds, used to work out when you reach
each sample. Pass the `route` tool's duration; omitted, a generic
80 km/h average is assumed and `duration_source` says so.

sample_interval_m.description:
Distance between samples in metres (default 25,000, clamped to
5,000 to 100,000; at most 40 samples per route).

shape.description:
The route shape as an encoded polyline6 (the `route` tool's
`geometry_polyline6`).

name: weather_along_route

WeatherSampleOut.description: One route sample's forecast, read for the hour you reach it.

arc_m.description: Distance along the route to this sample, metres.

available.description:
Whether real forecast data is present. `false` means every weather
field is absent and `unavailable_reason` says why; never a guess.

eta.description: Estimated time of arrival at this sample, RFC 3339 UTC.

precipitation_mm.description: Total precipitation for the hour, mm.

severe.description:
True for thunderstorm and heavy-precipitation WMO codes only.
Absent when the sample is unavailable.

unavailable_reason.description:
Why this sample has no data (beyond the forecast horizon, or the
forecast source could not be reached).

wind_gusts_kph.description: Gust speed, km/h: the figure that matters for high-sided vehicles.

attribution.description:
Data attribution (CC BY 4.0): display it with the forecast,
verbatim.

attribution_url.description:
The link the credit carries ("https://open-meteo.com/"): Open-Meteo's
licence asks for it next to any place its data is displayed.

depart_at.description: The departure time actually used, RFC 3339 UTC.

derived_fields.description:
The sample fields MapMap derives rather than reads from Open-Meteo
("precipitation_type", "severe"), so a display can indicate the
changes the licence asks to be indicated.

duration_s.description: The route duration actually used, seconds.

duration_source.description:
"provided" or "estimated_default_speed" (an 80 km/h guess: treat
the ETAs as approximate).

licence_url.description: The data licence to link with the credit (CC BY 4.0).

sample_interval_m.description:
The sample spacing actually used, metres (may be coarser than
asked on a long route).

severe_ahead.description: True when any available sample carries a severe WMO code.

summary.description:
One honest sentence describing the samples: where rain or snow
starts and for how far, the strongest gust, how many samples had
no data. Always ends by saying it is an advisory forecast, never a
routing guarantee.
